test_title: PYST 5: Selection Post (Matric Level) - GA (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Indian government scheme aims to provide free LPG connections to below-poverty-line families?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ujjwala Yojana**__.

**__Key Points__**

__

• The **Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)** was launched by the **Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas** to provide **clean cooking fuel** like **LPG** to rural and deprived households, which otherwise rely on traditional fuels such as firewood, coal, or cow-dung cakes. **Hence, this option is correct.**

• The scheme was officially launched on **1st May 2016** by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** in **Ballia, Uttar Pradesh**.

• The primary objective of the scheme is to **empower women** and protect their health by reducing the serious health hazards associated with **indoor air pollution** caused by fossil fuels.

• Under this scheme, the **Central Government** provides financial support of **Rs. 1600** for each **LPG connection** to the **BPL (Below Poverty Line)** households.

• **Ayushman Bharat** is a flagship health scheme aimed at providing **health insurance** of **Rs. 5 lakh** per family per year for secondary and tertiary care, rather than energy connections. **Hence, this option is incorrect.**

• **Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)** is an initiative to provide **income support** of **Rs. 6000** per year in three equal installments to all landholding **farmer families**. **Hence, this option is incorrect.**

• **Stand-Up India** was launched to facilitate **bank loans** between **Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore** to at least one **Scheduled Caste (SC)** or **Scheduled Tribe (ST)** borrower and at least one **woman** borrower per bank branch for setting up a **greenfield enterprise**. **Hence, this option is incorrect.**

**Additional Information__**

__

• **Ujjwala 2.0 (Phase II):** This phase was launched in **August 2021** from **Mahoba, Uttar Pradesh**. It aimed to cover an additional **1 crore** beneficiaries with a special focus on **migrant families** who may not have proof of address.

• **Implementation Agency:** The scheme is implemented through **Public Sector Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs)** such as **IOCL, BPCL, and HPCL**.

• **Eligibility Criteria:** The applicant must be a **woman** aged above **18 years** belonging to a **BPL** household, **SC/ST** categories, or beneficiaries of **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin)** and **Antyodaya Anna Yojana**.

• **Impact on Health:** According to the **World Health Organization (WHO)**, smoke from traditional fuels is equivalent to burning **400 cigarettes** in an hour, and **PMUY** has played a vital role in reducing **respiratory diseases** among rural women.

• **Environmental Benefit:** By promoting **LPG**, the scheme contributes to reducing **deforestation** and lowering **carbon emissions**, aligning with India's commitments under the **Paris Agreement**.

**Important Points__**

• **Financial Mechanism:** The **Rs. 1600** subsidy covers the **security deposit** of the cylinder, **pressure regulator**, **LPG hose**, and **installation charges**.

• **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** The subsidy for **LPG refills** is directly credited to the **bank accounts** of the beneficiaries under the **PAHAL (Pratyaksh Hanstantrit Labh)** scheme to ensure transparency and prevent leakages.

• **Milestones:** The initial target of providing **5 crore** connections was achieved in **2018**, which was subsequently increased to **8 crore** and achieved by **September 2019**, seven months ahead of the target **date**.

• **Global Recognition:** The **International Energy Agency (IEA)** has hailed **PMUY** as a major achievement in improving **energy access** and environment-friendly cooking solutions.
</ul
